# Attribution

- Chemical Methods Ontology (CHMO), Royal Society of Chemistry and
  contributors, CC BY 4.0: <https://github.com/rsc-ontologies/rsc-cmo>
- Environment Ontology (ENVO), ENVO contributors, CC0:
  <https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo>
- Analytical Methods and Open Spectral Database (AMOS), U.S. Environmental
  Protection Agency: <https://www.epa.gov/comptox-tools/analytical-methods-and-open-spectral-amos-database-user-guide>

Each release manifest records the exact ontology release identifiers, source
hashes, and AMOS snapshot hash used to build the released tables.
